indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat (Grabo). Automated alerts (PAGER, GDACS) are estimates that are revised; a revision is recorded, never hidden.
emerging_concerns: A hazard with an orange or red alert in a country no program watches goes to Watchfloor's review queue.

indicators.text: USGS PAGER alert of yellow or worse
indicators.rule: alert is yellow, orange or red

indicators.text: GDACS alert of orange or red

indicators.rule: a new activation in the area

indicators.text: An automated alert is lowered or withdrawn on revision
indicators.rule: a later update lowers the alert

warning_problems.title: A natural hazard becomes a disaster (anywhere)

watch_condition.current: set per event from EL-IND-1 to EL-IND-3

warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when an event's alert rises or an activation opens; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the alerts are lowered and any activation closes.

hypotheses.statement: Major human impact (deaths, displacement, lifelines down)
A large hazard with limited impact (remote, prepared or offshore)
Artefact: an automated estimate later revised down
